opinions.title: Communications Industry Update：Meta Muse accelerates agent commercialization while the Apsara Conference strengthens the full-stack AI strategy
opinions.opi_all:
{"description":" Key takeaway
Meta Muse and the Apsara Conference jointly reinforce the logic that AI application deployment drives computing power demand. Meta launched Muse, a personal AI assistant that supports email, travel bookings, and transaction execution. It recorded 2.8mn downloads within 12 days of launch and is advancing integration with Shopify's payment ecosystem to drive the commercialization of consumer AI agents. At the Apsara Conference, Alibaba disclosed that Qwen 4 is in training and that subsequent models are planned to scale toward 5–10 tn parameters. It also unveiled the Zhenwu V900 chip, set a target of exceeding 20 GW in global data center capacity by 2032, and promoted enterprise AI agent adoption through Qwen Office. We believe that as AI evolves from conversation to task execution, demand for inference, tool use, and cloud resources will continue to grow. We recommend focusing on high-speed transceivers, switches, servers, liquid cooling, power supplies, and other segments.
Market recap
The communications sector saw a pullback during the period. The communications (SWS) index fell 3.05%, underperforming the CSI 300 Index by 1.53 pcts. Among the communications subsectors covered by SWS, communication service (801223.SI) gained 0.47% while communication equipment (801102.SI) lost 3.53%.
